result.topic_en: A provisional invoice (Interims-Nota) from the Deuerlich bookshop in Göttingen, dated 30 June 1860, to Professor Riemann for one copy of the 1859 accessions catalogue of the Royal University Library, priced 15 Silbergroschen.
